name: Tofu Gnocchi in Spicy Tomato Sauce (Fra Diavolo) with Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
1 red chili pepper
½ (5 oz) pkg baby arugula
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp honey
⅛ tsp salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pan is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (16 oz) pkg potato gnocchi
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the gnocchi is cooking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in another medium bowl, then sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper. Gently toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp cornstarch
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, turning occasionally, until golden, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.

Quarter chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the shallot and garlic. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, garlic, chili pepper, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the skillet, along with the tofu and drained gnocchi, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl with the dressing, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
To serve, divide tofu gnocchi and salad between plates or bowls. Sprinkle gnocchi with crushed red pepper and reserved Parmesan. Enjoy!
